prompt: This harness fuzzes libxslt's XSLT stylesheet processing pipeline via `xsltFuzzXslt`, feeding arbitrary byte sequences as combined stylesheet-and-document input to exercise parsing, compilation, and transformation logic. The fuzzer targets the full chain from XML/XSLT parsing through template matching and output serialization, looking for crashes, memory corruption, use-after-free errors, infinite loops, and other undefined behaviors that can arise when malformed or adversarial stylesheets interact with the transformation engine.
